import os, sys
import pandas as pd
from pydeseq2.dds import DeseqDataSet
from pydeseq2.ds import DeseqStats

counts = pd.read_csv('inputs/Issy_ASXL1_blood_featureCounts_GeneTable_final.txt', sep=r'\\s+', engine='python')
counts = counts.set_index('Geneid')
coldata = pd.read_excel('inputs/Issy_ASXL1_blood_coldata_gender.xlsx')
coldata = coldata.dropna(how='all')
coldata = coldata.loc[coldata['sample'].notna(), ['sample','condition','sex']].copy()
coldata['sample'] = coldata['sample'].astype(str)
coldata = coldata.set_index('sample')
# keep only samples present in both, metadata order
samples = [s for s in coldata.index if s in counts.columns]
missing_counts = [s for s in coldata.index if s not in counts.columns]
extra_counts = [s for s in counts.columns if s not in coldata.index]
print('samples', len(samples), samples)
print('missing_counts', missing_counts)
print('extra_counts', extra_counts)
metadata = coldata.loc[samples].copy()
metadata['condition'] = pd.Categorical(metadata['condition'], categories=['Control','ASXL1'])
metadata['sex'] = pd.Categorical(metadata['sex'], categories=['F','M'])
cts = counts[samples].T.astype(int)
print('shape', cts.shape)
print(metadata.groupby(['condition','sex'], observed=False).size())

dds = DeseqDataSet(counts=cts, metadata=metadata, design='~ sex + condition', ref_level=['condition','Control'], refit_cooks=True, n_cpus=1, quiet=False)
dds.deseq2()
print('variables', dds.variables)
stat = DeseqStats(dds, contrast=['condition','ASXL1','Control'], alpha=0.05, cooks_filter=True, independent_filter=True, quiet=False, n_cpus=1)
stat.summary()
print('results cols', stat.results_df.columns.tolist())
print(stat.results_df.head())
print('LFC columns', stat.LFC.columns.tolist())
coeff = 'condition_ASXL1_vs_Control'
if coeff not in stat.LFC.columns:
    print('coeff not found; available', stat.LFC.columns.tolist())
    coeff = [c for c in stat.LFC.columns if 'condition' in c and 'ASXL1' in c and 'Control' in c][0]
stat.lfc_shrink(coeff=coeff)
res = stat.results_df
print('after shrink cols', res.columns.tolist())
print(res.head())
count = int((res['padj'] < 0.05).sum())
print('SIGNIF_COUNT', count)
print('padj nonna', res['padj'].notna().sum(), 'NA', res['padj'].isna().sum())
PY"

import os
import pandas as pd
from pydeseq2.dds import DeseqDataSet
from pydeseq2.ds import DeseqStats

counts = pd.read_csv('inputs/Issy_ASXL1_blood_featureCounts_GeneTable_final.txt', sep=r'\\s+', engine='python').set_index('Geneid')

metadata = coldata.loc[samples].copy()
metadata['condition'] = pd.Categorical(metadata['condition'], categories=['Control','ASXL1'])
metadata['sex'] = pd.Categorical(metadata['sex'], categories=['F','M'])
cts = counts[samples].T.astype(int)

dds = DeseqDataSet(counts=cts, metadata=metadata, design='~ sex + condition', refit_cooks=True, n_cpus=4, quiet=True)

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(DESeq2)
  library(apeglm)
  library(readxl)
})
counts <- read.table('inputs/Issy_ASXL1_blood_featureCounts_GeneTable_final.txt', header=TRUE, check.names=FALSE, row.names=1)
coldata <- as.data.frame(read_excel('inputs/Issy_ASXL1_blood_coldata_gender.xlsx'))
coldata <- coldata["'!is.na(coldata$sample), c('"'sample','condition','sex')]
rownames(coldata) <- coldata"'$sample
samples <- intersect(coldata$sample, colnames(counts))
# Preserve metadata order, excluding count columns without metadata
samples <- coldata$sample[coldata$sample %in% colnames(counts)]
coldata <- coldata[samples, , drop=FALSE]
counts <- counts[, samples, drop=FALSE]
coldata$condition <- factor(coldata$condition, levels=c('"'Control','ASXL1'))
coldata"'$sex <- factor(coldata$sex, levels=c('"'F','M'))
cat('matched_samples', length(samples), '\\n')
cat('extra_count_cols', paste(setdiff(colnames(read.table('inputs/Issy_ASXL1_blood_featureCounts_GeneTable_final.txt', header=TRUE, check.names=FALSE, nrows=1)[-1]), rownames(coldata)), collapse=','), '\\n')
print(table(coldata"'$condition, coldata$sex))
dds <- DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(countData=round(as.matrix(counts)), colData=coldata, design=~ sex + condition)
dds <- DESeq(dds)
print(resultsNames(dds))
res <- results(dds, name='"'condition_ASXL1_vs_Control', alpha=0.05)
shr <- lfcShrink(dds, coef='condition_ASXL1_vs_Control', res=res, type='apeglm')
count <- sum(shr"'$padj < 0.05, na.rm=TRUE)
cat('"'SIGNIF_COUNT', count, '\\n')
cat('padj_non_na', sum("'!is.na(shr$padj)), '"'\\n')
dir.create('codex_output', showWarnings=FALSE)
writeLines(as.character(count), 'codex_output/answer.txt')
RS"

suppressPackageStartupMessages(library(DESeq2)); suppressPackageStartupMessages(library(readxl))
counts <- read.table('inputs/Issy_ASXL1_blood_featureCounts_GeneTable_final.txt', header=TRUE, check.names=FALSE, row.names=1)
coldata <- as.data.frame(read_excel('inputs/Issy_ASXL1_blood_coldata_gender.xlsx'))
coldata <- coldata["'!is.na(coldata$sample), c('"'sample','condition','sex')]
rownames(coldata) <- coldata"'$sample
samples <- coldata$sample[coldata$sample %in% colnames(counts)]
coldata <- coldata[samples,,drop=FALSE]
counts <- counts[,samples,drop=FALSE]
coldata$condition <- factor(coldata$condition, levels=c('"'Control','ASXL1'))
coldata"'$sex <- factor(coldata$sex, levels=c('"'F','M'))
dds <- DESeq(DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(round(as.matrix(counts)), coldata, ~ sex + condition), quiet=TRUE)
res05 <- results(dds, name='condition_ASXL1_vs_Control', alpha=0.05)
res10 <- results(dds, name='condition_ASXL1_vs_Control')
res_noif <- results(dds, name='condition_ASXL1_vs_Control', independentFiltering=FALSE)
cat('alpha05', sum(res05"'$padj < 0.05, na.rm=TRUE), '"'nonNA', sum("'!is.na(res05$padj)), '"'\\n')
cat('defaultAlpha', sum(res10"'$padj < 0.05, na.rm=TRUE), '"'nonNA', sum("'!is.na(res10$padj)), '"'\\n')
cat('noIndependentFiltering', sum(res_noif"'$padj < 0.05, na.rm=TRUE), '"'nonNA', sum("'!is.na(res_noif$padj)), '"'\\n')
RS"
